mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_ROLERES_REF rr WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES res WHERE rr.resource_id = res.id AND res.main_id = #{mid} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.ID, r.MAIN_ID, r.RESOURCE_DESC, r.RESOURCE_URL, r.RESOURCE_TYPE, CASE WHEN rr.ROLE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CHECKED FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON r.ID = rr.RESOURCE_ID AND rr.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY r.MAIN_ID ASC
